title.zh: 退火做什么：热是手段，材料变化才是目的
title.en: What annealing does: heat is the means; material change is the goal

subtitle.zh: 激活、修复、扩散、相变、致密化与界面钝化
subtitle.en: Activation, repair, diffusion, phase change, densification and interface passivation

body.zh: 退火是多种热处理任务的统称，不同任务需要不同温度轨迹。
body.en: Annealing is a collective term for thermal-processing tasks; different tasks require different temperature trajectories.

body.zh: 激活掺杂掺杂原子进入电活性晶格位置
body.en: Dopant activation Dopant atoms occupy Electrically active lattice sites

body.zh: 修复晶格原子重排与缺陷复合，恢复周期性
body.en: Lattice repair Atomic rearrangement and defect Recombination restore periodicity

body.zh: 控制扩散调控掺杂或杂质的空间分布
body.en: Diffusion control Control the spatial distribution Of dopants or impurities

body.zh: 形成新相发生相变或生成新结构相
body.en: New-phase formation A phase change occurs or A new structural phase forms

body.zh: 薄膜致密化孔隙减少，原子堆积更致密
body.en: Film densification Fewer pores; atoms Pack more densely

body.zh: 界面钝化缺陷与悬键减少，界面态被钝化
body.en: Interface passivation Fewer defects and dangling bonds; Interface states are passivated

body.zh: 明确材料初态• 结构/成分/缺陷• 掺杂分布• 既有应力与相态
body.en: Establish the initial material state • Structure / composition / defects • Dopant distribution • Existing stress and phase state

body.zh: 确定目标变化• 选择期望的材料变化• 设定关键指标方向• 定义可接受的副作用
body.en: Define the target change • Select the desired material change • Define the direction of key metrics • Define acceptable side effects

body.zh: 检查热预算•允许的热负荷上限• 与前道/后道的兼容• 关键层的热稳定性
body.en: Check the thermal budget • Upper limit of permissible thermal load • Compatibility with preceding / subsequent processes • Thermal stability of critical layers

body.zh: 选择气氛与加热方式• 气氛类型与纯度• 压力范围• 加热方式选择
body.en: Select the ambient and Heating method • Ambient type and purity • Pressure range • Heating-method selection

body.zh: 升温/驻留/冷却•升温阶段•高温驻留阶段•冷却阶段
body.en: Heating / dwell / cooling • Heating stage • High-temperature dwell stage • Cooling stage

body.zh: 量测确认• 与目标对比• 判定是否达成• 决定是否迭代
body.en: Confirm by metrology • Compare against the target • Determine whether it has been achieved • Decide whether to iterate

body.zh: 峰值温度决定可激活能量、扩散驱动力与相变可能性。
body.en: Peak temperature Determines available activation energy, Diffusion driving force and the possibility Of phase change.

body.zh: 有效时间影响反应充分性与扩散深度，存在临界与饱和效应。
body.en: Effective time Affects reaction completeness and Diffusion depth, with threshold And saturation effects.

body.zh: 升降温速率影响热应力、相变路径与缺陷生成/消除。
body.en: Heating and cooling rates Affect thermal stress, Phase-transformation paths and Defect generation / elimination.

body.zh: 气氛与压力影响氧化还原、挥发/沉积平衡与界面化学。
body.en: Ambient and pressure Affect redox reactions, Evaporation / deposition equilibrium And interface chemistry.

body.zh: 耦合与权衡（相互制约）激活增强掺杂扩散
body.en: Couplings and tradeoffs (mutual constraints) Stronger activation Dopant diffusion

body.zh: 反应充分团聚/ 应力 / 界面反应
body.en: Complete reaction Agglomeration / stress / interfacial reaction

body.zh: 说明：局部最优不一定等于整合最优，需在多目标之间权衡。
body.en: Note: a local optimum is not necessarily an integration optimum; multiple objectives require tradeoffs.

body.zh: 潜在风险（并非必然发生）激活不足扩散过深残余晶格缺陷薄膜开裂金属团聚
body.en: Potential risks (not inevitable) Insufficient activation Excessive diffusion depth Residual lattice defects Film cracking Metal agglomeration

body.zh: 风险水平取决于材料体系、热轨迹与工艺窗口。
body.en: Risk depends on the material system, thermal trajectory and process window.

body.zh: 量测反馈：Rs / Hall · SIMS · TEM / XRD · C–V / I–V
body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / Hall · SIMS · TEM / XRD · C–V / I–V

body.zh: 四探针（Rs）
body.en: Four-point probe (Rs)

body.zh: SIMS（深度分布）
body.en: SIMS (depth distribution)

body.zh: TEM/ XRD（结构）
body.en: TEM / XRD (structure)

body.zh: C-V/I-V（电学）
body.en: C–V / I–V (electrical)

body.zh: 浓度深度
body.en: Concentration Depth

body.zh: C或IV_th10⁻³10⁻⁶10⁻⁹
body.en: C or I V_th 10⁻³ 10⁻⁶ 10⁻⁹

body.zh: 下游影响（器件层面）结深接触电阻阈值电压漏电可靠性良率
body.en: Downstream effects (device level) Junction depth Contact resistance Threshold voltage Leakage Reliability Yield

body.zh: 退火可按热源、温度轨迹、气氛或工艺目的命名，类别可能交叉。
body.en: Annealing may be named by heat source, temperature trajectory, ambient or process purpose; categories may overlap.

body.en: R_c

body.en: I

body.en: V

body.en: Δt
